messages:
sofia_cs: FYI AprilBridge started their APAC pilot and immediately hit the per-minute throttle. They asked if we can add a short-lived CIDR exception and bump per-route burst for /v1/chat to validate throughput.

nora_acct: Marking renewal risk as medium if pilot can't show stable perf. They want a 9-day window and are requesting burst=500 rps from staging CIDR.

sofia_cs: @rex_net can we add 203.0.115.0/28 and 198.51.102.128/28 to an allowlist and add header match X-Env:april-stg? Will need auto-revoke.

rex_net: Yes. Plan: add ipset entries + rate window with TTL=9d and header allowlist. Suggest global_soft=700 to allow short spikes.

liam_sre: Tagging SRE for quick risk review. I'll run capacity/noisy-neighbor check. If needed, enable small-model fallback on overload. ETA 30m.

preflight-bot: APAC health: clear. Recommend KV prewarm for aprilbridge prefix and set p95 alert at 1500ms.

rex_net: Draft change snippet:

```
# AprilBridge temp allowlist + rate window (auto-revoke 9d)
ipset add aprilbridge_203 203.0.115.0/28
ipset add aprilbridge_198 198.51.102.128/28
route /v1/chat burst=500 per_route_soft=500 global_soft=700 headers.allow=X-Env:april-stg
# tag: aprilbridge-pilot-3401234567
```

rex_net: Opening JIRA INF-9901. Rollback scheduled after 9d (auto-revoke webhook).

sofia_cs: Customer telem: 200-350ms median in us-west but 1.0-1.4s p95 in ap-northeast during bursts. They asked about region pin to ap-northeast-1 if we can show cost delta.

liam_sre: We can add token-level routing pinning to ap-northeast-1. That cuts RTT but ups egress/cost. I'll calculate a cost delta and send to @nora_acct.

nora_acct: Please send cost delta before pinning. Also note in renewal tracker that CS provided a pilot concession.

sofia_cs: Scheduling a 30-45m enablement + runbook session on Friday to validate prompts and monitor hallucination/quality under load.

liam_sre: Change applied to staging; smoke tests green. Rolling to prod in 10. Alerts: p95 > 1600ms triggers rollback + small-model fallback.

rex_net: Live now. CIDRs allowed, rate window active, header match enforced. Watchlist created: aprilbridge-3401234567.

sofia_cs: Please ping when live so I can notify customer and run the Friday session. We'll capture sentiment and quality regressions after 24h.

nora_acct: I'll prepare usage + cost summary for day 7 and follow up on renewal outreach.

sofia_cs: Thanks team.
